simple.meaning: שַׁבָּת (shabbâth) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “intermission , i.e (specifically) the Sabbath.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 111 times across Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, 2 Kings, and 8 more, beginning at Exodus 16:23. Its contexts include family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שַׁבָּת (H7676).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שַׁבָּת (shabbâth) / H7676 is traced through Exodus 16:23, Exodus 16:25, Exodus 16:26, Exodus 16:29 as a generated source-based concept entry.
